sourceConflictNote: The English PDF's December 2027 month grid repeats 15 in the Friday cell where 17 belongs, while its second-page details list no event on December 17. The Arabic translation also describes May 25 as a teacher workday and 'last day for students,' while the English, Spanish, and French details identify May 24 as the last student day and May 25 as the last teacher day. The PDF additionally lists 171 student days and 191 teacher days, but its printed quarter instructional totals of 41, 46, 45, and 43 add up to 175, while its staff-day totals of 48, 53, 51, and 45 add up to 197. A MySchoolDates date-by-date count suggests Quarter 3 may contain 41 student days rather than the printed 45, but CPS has not published corrected quarter figures. This page follows the English details list for dated events, uses May 24 as the last student day, and leaves the staff-day totals unreconciled.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Cincinnati Public Schools start in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: CPS's current calendar lists Wednesday, August 18, 2027, as the first day for students. Teacher workdays are August 11–12, followed by professional-development days August 13 and 16–17.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Cincinnati CPS Thanksgiving Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Students are out November 22–26, 2027. November 24 is the Teacher Conference Exchange Day; schools and the central office close November 25–26.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Cincinnati CPS Winter Recess in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Recess runs December 20–31, 2027. January 3 is a no-student professional-development day, and schools reopen Tuesday, January 4, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Cincinnati CPS Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 20 through Friday, March 24, 2028. Schools reopen Monday, March 27.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day for Cincinnati CPS students in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day and end of Quarter 4 is Wednesday, May 24, 2028. May 25 is the last teacher classroom workday.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are on the Cincinnati CPS 2027–28 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists 171 student days and 191 teacher days, but both sets of printed quarter totals fail to reconcile with those annual figures. A date-by-date count suggests Quarter 3 may contain 41 student days rather than the printed 45; CPS has not published corrected quarter totals.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the repeated December 15 in the CPS PDF create a calendar event?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The English month grid repeats 15 where Friday the 17th belongs, but the details page lists no December 17 event, so December 17 is not included here.

calendarFaqs.q: Is May 24 or May 25 the last student day in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: May 24 is the last student day. English, Spanish, and French agree that May 25 is the final teacher workday; the Arabic May 25 line contains an inconsistent student label.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 15, 2026 against all eight pages of the official English, Spanish, French, and Arabic 2027–28 PDFs. The English PDF reviewed matches the current CPS download.
sourceReviewDetails: Confirmed that the PDF prints 171 student days, 191 teacher days, the instructional-hour range, instructional quarter totals of 41, 46, 45, and 43 that add up to 175, and staff quarter totals of 48, 53, 51, and 45 that add up to 197. A MySchoolDates date-by-date count finds 44 weekdays from January 18 through March 17, less the February 7, February 21, and March 6 student closures, for an apparent Quarter 3 student total of 41. That would reconcile the annual student total, but CPS has not published corrected student or staff quarter figures; the staff totals remain unreconciled.
Documented the repeated December 15 in the English grid and confirmed that no language details page lists a December 17 event.
Resolved the Arabic May 25 label against the English, Spanish, and French details, which agree that May 24 is the last student day and May 25 is the last teacher workday.
